presentation.speaker: elena
presentation.title: Elena Park wants in
lines: I'll put $40,000 into {company} for 20% of it. Today, if you like.
Money now, a partner forever. Your call.

choices.label: Take $40,000 for 20%
choices.detail: Sign her term sheet as offered. Cash in the company now, no repayments. You own 80% from here on; she will want quarterly numbers.
choices.outcome: Elena: "Welcome to the portfolio. I'll want monthly numbers."

choices.label: Read the term sheet first
choices.detail: She leaves the term sheet with you for 30 days. Counter it or sign it later from Fundraising in Company OS; nothing is paid until you sign.
choices.outcome: Elena: "Read every line. The sheet stands for thirty days."

choices.label: Not now
choices.detail: Keep 100%. Find the cash another way.
choices.outcome: Elena: "Smart founders say no more than yes. Offer stands for a while."
